findings.passage: Adding unnecessary and expensive barriers to vote will disenfranchise millions of U.S. citizens and disproportionately impact communities of color. To be clear, it is already illegal under federal law for noncitizens to cast a ballot.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name after his vote against H.R. 22 (SAVE Act). Says the bill adds document barriers to voting and that non-citizen voting is already illegal under federal law.

findings.passage: This bill will prevent Americans from using their driver’s license or military ID in order to register to vote.
findings.note: Same statement. Describes what H.R. 22 would change about which IDs are accepted to register.

findings.passage: Let’s be clear: there is no evidence of any meaningful amount of voter fraud committed by non-citizens, and requiring all citizens to compile excessive, sometimes expensive, documentation of their citizenship will only serve to disenfranchise many qualified voters.
findings.note: Joint statement by Scott and Rep. Judy Chu before the House vote on H.R. 8281 (SAVE Act), issued by the two as caucus and task-force chairs. It is a joint statement, not Scott alone.
subjects: documentary proof of citizenship to register (SAVE Act)

findings.passage: Instead of passing voter suppression bills, the House and Senate should instead take up and pass the Freedom to Vote Act and John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, which would work in tandem to protect and strengthen our democracy and our freedom to vote.
findings.note: Same joint statement. Names two other bills he wants passed instead.

findings.passage: In no uncertain terms, we believe this order is unconstitutional, illegal, and impractical, could result in millions of voters being disenfranchised, and opens the door for false and misleading accusations of impropriety from your Administration.
findings.note: Letter to the President signed by Scott as a co-chair of the Congressional Voting Rights Caucus, with other members, about the March 25, 2025 executive order that directs documentary proof of citizenship for voter registration. A group letter, not Scott alone.
subjects: documentary proof of citizenship to register (SAVE Act)

findings.passage: This decision also perpetuates the falsehood that noncitizens are voting in meaningful numbers and former President Trump’s plan to undermine confidence in our elections.
findings.note: Scott's statement on the Supreme Court order allowing Virginia to continue removing voters from the rolls close to the 2024 election. He says the removals rest on a false claim about non-citizen voting.

findings.passage: This bill will prevent Americans from using their driver’s license or military ID in order to register to vote. It will also eliminate existing voter registration methods, including registering via mail or online.
findings.note: Statement issued in Scott's name after his vote against H.R. 22 (SAVE Act). He describes the bill's effect on which IDs can be used to register and on mail and online registration.
